notes: Losers bracket round 2: players dropping from the winners bracket now enter in mirrored order (the loser of the first winners match plays last in that losers round, the loser of the last one plays first), later losers rounds keep the usual order. Applies to newly created or reset brackets
Every TBD slot in the winners bracket, losers bracket and grand final now shows who is expected there (e.g. "Winner WB R1 #3", "Loser WB R2 #1"); hover shows the real players when known

Swap players now also works on TBD slots: in swap mode a TBD slot shows which earlier match feeds it (e.g. "Winner R1 #3") and can be swapped with another slot of the same round in the winners bracket, so a bracket can be rewired to mirror an external backup bracket
Swapping two named players works exactly as before
Double elimination positions: players knocked out in the same losers round now share a position and the same points (5th-6th, 7th-8th, 9th-12th, ...)
Score Settings only lists the positions that exist for the number of players in a double elimination bracket (e.g. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 for 8 players)
Final Championship: new tournament type — double elimination played over a shared pool of games chosen at creation (minimum 11)
Participant tiers: mark participants as Champion or Winner before the start; Winners enter the bracket one round and Champions two rounds after everyone else
Pick & ban flow run by the admin per match: FT2 sets up to the semifinals, FT3 in both semifinals, FT5 in the finals and grand final. Every set is a game played to 3 rounds
Progress is saved after every pick, ban and set, so a match can be resumed after a refresh; brackets show the running set score
Fixed match formats: win-condition controls are hidden for Final Championship tournaments and players can only be swapped within the same tier
Mobile responsiveness: header now wraps on narrow screens, display name hidden on phones, version badges compacted
Fix: admin sidebar no longer disappears on iPhone — collapsed state now has explicit 44px height so the toggle button is always visible
Fix: Reset Bracket button is hidden when tournament is complete
Fix: double elimination grand final reset match (gf-m1) no longer blocks tournament completion when winners bracket player wins the grand final
Fix: scores now correctly auto-awarded when a double elimination tournament completes without a bracket reset
Existing user linking: approving a public registration reuses an existing user doc with the same name instead of creating a duplicate, preserving accumulated scores
Public registration: tournament admins generate shareable registration links; anyone with the link can sign up with just their name
Pending approvals: admin approves or denies each registration from the Tournament Detail page before they appear as participants
Participant name uniqueness: participantNameSet on tournament documents prevents duplicate names across all add flows
Bracket share links: admins generate expiring bracket links (30 days) from the started tournament page; link resolves via bracketTokens collection
Firestore rules: registrationTokens, registrationEntries, and bracketTokens collections with permissive public reads and gated creates
Error modals: registration link errors shown in a modal instead of a bottom toast
Fix: multi-use invite links no longer break after the first use (usedCount correctly tracks remaining uses)
Game picker: search thousands of fighting games via start.gg API with live search-as-you-type
Game images: box art shown on tournament cards, detail page, and game picker
Twitch link: add a Twitch stream URL to tournaments, shown as icon on cards and detail page
Tournament description: add a full description when creating tournaments
Custom tournament image: add a banner image URL to your tournament (shown as card thumbnail)
Registration start/end: both dates now shown on card tiles with times
Registration logic: Join Open badge only appears after registration start date has passed
INT environment: new isolated Firebase project (tfs-bracket-dev) for integration testing
Env-specific release notes: release notes now filtered by environment
Display name: first-time login prompts for a display name; shown consistently across Header, Leaderboard, and participant lists
Discord external ID: immutable Discord snowflake stored on user doc for identity linking
Auth flash fix: loading guard waits for authorization to resolve before rendering tournament list
Tournament query fix: onSnapshot re-subscribes on login so tournaments appear after invite acceptance
Toast notifications: new toast system replaces all alert() calls with styled, auto-dismiss notifications (success/error/info)
Modal accessibility: all modals support Escape to close, have role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-label, and auto-focus the first focusable element
Async feedback: all write operations show inline loading spinners (Publishing..., Starting..., Joining..., Creating...)
Logout confirmation: sign out now requires a BaseModal confirmation instead of one-click logout
Dismissible invite banner: invite result banner can be closed with × button
Inline form validation: Create Tournament form shows field-level errors instead of alert() dialogs
BaseModal for all confirmations: reset bracket, remove participant, and delete now use proper modals instead of confirm()
Loading skeletons: tournament list shows shimmer skeleton cards while data loads; leaderboard shows skeleton rows
Staggered entrance: tournament cards and leaderboard rows appear one by one with subtle delay
Empty state icons: tournament list, bracket, leaderboard, and participant lists show emoji icons above empty messages
Avatar loading: initials shown immediately as placeholder while profile image loads asynchronously
prefers-reduced-motion: all animations respect the system accessibility setting
Sidebar aria-label: collapse/expand toggle button has accessible label
Discord login: sign in with Discord (purple button) alongside Google
Invite links: shareable multi-use invite links with expiry and max-use limits
Invite modal: tabbed interface for email invites vs link invites
Avatar fallback: shows coloured initials circle when profile photo is missing
Registration gate: controlled via VITE_ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION env var (dev only)
Restricted access: separate page for unauthorised users, no app chrome visible
Player join: registered players can join open tournaments during registration window
Security overhaul: Firestore rules rewritten with role-based access on all collections
Score awarding: tournament admins can award points to participants on completion
Transaction safety: invite consumption uses runTransaction to prevent race conditions
Leaderboard filter: only users with score > 0 appear in rankings
Security headers: X-Frame-Options, HSTS, and other HTTP security headers added
Env split: .env for UAT deployment, .env.dev for development via vite --mode dev
Leaderboard: view cumulative scores across all tournaments in real time
Player management: edit or remove participants before the tournament starts
Custom scoring: set how many points each finishing rank is worth
Auto-scoring: points are automatically awarded when a tournament completes
Navigation: quick links to switch between Tournaments and Leaderboard
Score badges: see each player's total points next to their name in the rankings
Disqualification: mark a player as DQ'd instead of entering a numeric score
Smoother interface: improved button feedback, transitions, and animations throughout the app
Session persistence: auth state survives page refresh with styled loading screen
Navigation persistence: current view and selected tournament restored from localStorage
Join confirmation: modal confirmation step before joining a tournament
Invite rework: tournament admins see link-only tab with role locked to Player; super admins see both tabs
Firestore rules: invite creation allowed for tournament admins (isAdmin, not just isSuperAdmin)
URL cleanup: invite query param removed from URL after processing to prevent re-validation
Add Participant: unified picklist for existing users plus name field for new players
Manual user creation: tournament admins create user docs (provider:manual, role:player) for score eligibility
Firestore rules: admin-created manual user docs allowed with provider/role validation
Fix resolutions: white screen when navigating between pages
Fix resolutions: page crash when switching to or from Leaderboard
Fix resolutions: error popup about React hooks ordering
Invite-only access: only invited users can log in
Role system: Super Admin, Tournament Admin, and Player roles
Single & double elimination brackets: supports odd number of players and grand final reset
Score recording: click a match to enter scores via a compact modal
Win conditions: configure how many wins are needed per match
Player swap: admins can move players between unfilled match slots
Round names: matches show their stage (Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Grand Final, etc.)
Compact bracket view: clean tile layout that fits on screen
Post-tournament rankings: automatically calculated and displayed with medals
Participant management: add players manually with name and optional email
Completed tournaments: marked clearly and sorted to the bottom
Modern design: updated look with smooth animations throughout
Security: input validation on all forms
